signature.name: VTask.reflection
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {M : Type u_2} -> [CommRing R] -> [AddCommGroup M] -> [Module R M] -> {x : M} -> {f : Module.Dual R M} -> (h : f x = 2) -> M ≃ₗ[R] M

conventions.statement: The condition f x = 2 (rather than 1 or any other value) is the standard root-system convention; it is precisely what makes the map y ↦ y − (f y) • x an involution.
conventions.note: This is a hypothesis, not a convention imposed on a junk value; the definition is simply undefined when f x ≠ 2.

facts.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) (M : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (x : M) (f : Module.Dual R M) (h : f x = 2), Function.Bijective (VTask.reflection h)
